mapper.select: select * from fund_use_record where use_record_id=#{useRecordId} and del_flag='0'
select * from fund_use_record where use_plan_id=#{usePlanId} and del_flag='0' order by use_time desc,use_record_id desc
select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from fund_use_record where use_plan_id=#{usePlanId} and del_flag='0'
select coalesce(sum(r.amount),0) from fund_use_record r join fund_use_plan p on p.use_plan_id=r.use_plan_id and p.del_flag='0' where p.topic_id=#{topicId} and r.del_flag='0'
select count(1) from fund_use_record where use_plan_id=#{usePlanId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update fund_use_record set use_name=#{useName},amount=#{amount},use_time=#{useTime},fund_desc=#{fundDesc},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where use_record_id=#{useRecordId} and del_flag='0'
update fund_use_record set del_flag='2',update_time=sysdate() where use_record_id=#{useRecordId}
